question: Amit steps out of his house and walks 76 m towards the north. He takes a right turn and walks 23 m. He takes a right turn again and walks 61 m. Then he takes a left turn and walks 20 m. Then he takes a right turn and walks 34 m. He takes a final right turn and walks 43 m to reach a library. How far and in which direction is the library from Amit's house? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
